description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the specific AI-flavor signals to fix. 2. Citation spacing: every occurrence of `Word(Author et al., YEAR)` must be fixed to `Word (Author et al., YEAR)` with a space before the opening paren — e.g., `models(Brown et al., 2020)` → `models (Brown et al., 2020)`. 3. Em-dash removal: all em-dash characters (—) connecting clauses must be eliminated and rewritten as independent sentences or comma-separated clauses — e.g., the abstract and multiple body sentences have double em-dash interruptions. 4. Emphasis quotes: seven scare-quoted phrases like "annotation burden", "generalization capability", "long-horizon", etc., must have their quotes stripped entirely (not replaced with bold/italic). 5. Math vector/matrix notation: bare `$x$`, `$W$`, `$v$`, `$q$`, `$z$`, `$K$`, `$V$` that represent vectors or matrices must be changed to `$\mathbf{x}$`, `$\mathbf{W}$`, etc., while true scalars like `$t$`, `$\alpha$`, `$N$`, `$d$` stay unbolded. 6. Over-citation: the Experiments Setup paragraph lists 5 baselines each with their own citation in one paragraph — this must be consolidated to 2-3 representative works, keeping the full list only in Related Work. 7. The output file must remain valid LaTeX with \begin{document} and \end{document} intact.
